title: FER student protest at Politécnico Manuel María Castillo
location: Politécnico Manuel María Castillo and surrounding sector, San Francisco de Macorís
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; the article describes students as a group but gives no simultaneous attendance count or clear qualitative size. Pending threshold.

occurrence.summary: Contemporaneous Diario Libre reports student protest action in/around the named school and a two-day protest.

start_date.summary: Article explicitly says students protested on Thursday 21 Nov; it also describes an ongoing two-day period, so earliest onset may be earlier and remains unresolved.

location.summary: Named Polytechnic in San Francisco de Macorís and its surrounding sector.

demands.summary: Students demanded cafeteria, director change, library/lab renovation and school expansion; domestic public-education decisions.

state_target.summary: Demands concern public school administration/facilities; Ministry of Education intervened.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown; no participant count or clear qualitative crowd estimate.

protester_violence.summary: Tires, stones and debris reported, but violence against state actors is not established.

state_response.summary: Diario Libre says police entered the school and some youths were detained; Ministry of Education condemned police entry. No beatings/shootings/killing reported; other responses unknown.

end_date.summary: Unknown; educational activities suspended for remainder of week but that is not proof protest ended.

notes: Body conflicts on whether event first occurred Thursday or had already lasted two days; date 21 Nov is earliest explicitly dated protest, not confirmed initial onset. School/day-to-day class disruption is not attendance. This remains separate from the October SFM strike; no organization or continuity link is established.
open_questions: Did at least 50 students gather simultaneously at any point?
What is the initial date within the described two-day action?
Did the protest end when classes were suspended, and is there later activity?
Does any independent source corroborate event attendance and describe the police response?

organizer: Local residents / no formal organizer identified

end_date.summary: Unknown; no closure or duration reported.

notes: One contemporary report identifies several locations and active protest, but does not quantify turnout or show simultaneous attendance; multiple sites are not summed. State shots were reportedly fired toward the ground; no killings inferred. This is a single-source event report.
open_questions: Was at least 50 people gathered simultaneously at any one location?
Did demonstrations continue after the night of 12 November?
